$comment: The Swift wire types of the daemon's conversation commands that scripts/cmux-next/gen-conversation-wire.py
writes at build time (ConversationWireTypesPlugin) from cmux-tui/spec/sdk-schema.json. One entry per Swift type:
name (Parent.Child: nested, written in an extension of Parent), doc, request (the command; the request shape
validates the fields), response, capability (a DaemonCapability case; "=text" a literal; absent: none),
schema (a data type's shape: request:CMD, result:CMD, type:NAME, event:NAME; absent: the schema has none,
as for Cloud results it types JsonValue), partial (a data type may skip the shape's required keys), conforms,
statics, init (public, internal or false; requests default to public), fields (wire key to: type, name, doc,
default (the init parameter's), fallback (decoded when absent), value (a stored initial value, not an init
parameter), set (the init's expression), let, extra (not in the schema shape)).
Field order is the init's parameter order. Hand-written helpers live in extensions beside the old files.

LocalRequests.name: ConversationSnapshotRequest
LocalRequests.doc: `conversation-snapshot`: the head and the newest `tail` messages (1...500).

actor.doc: Omitted: the owner stamps the connection's principal.

LocalRequests.name: ConversationOpRequest
LocalRequests.doc: `conversation-op`: one typed op; the reply and the event carry `transaction`.

actor.doc: Omitted: the owner stamps the connection's principal.

LocalRequests.name: ConversationLinkResolveRequest
doc: `conversation-link-resolve` (conversation-tree-v1): a permalink's conversation, message, the
message's top thread root and the path from that root down to it.

LocalRequests.name: ConversationThreadRequest
LocalRequests.doc: `conversation-thread`: the root and up to `limit` (1...500) replies after `afterSeq`.

LocalRequests.name: ConversationImportRequest
doc: `conversation-import` (cmux-tui conversation_import.rs): appends history
from another store once, keeping authors and times; the owner assigns
seqs and skips what it already holds. Local user connections only.

LocalRequests.name: ConversationLiveRequest
doc: `conversation-live {conversation}` (`chief-live-v1`): the local owner's
`run.live` snapshot of a conversation, the text so far and the activity of
every running run. Home asks when it opens a conversation and after a gap.

LocalRequests.name: ConversationRunRequest
LocalRequests.doc: `conversation-run {conversation, run}` (`conversation-runs-v1`): every step of a local run.

LocalResults.name: ConversationSnapshot
LocalResults.doc: `conversation-snapshot` data: the head and the newest messages, ascending.

threads.doc: The owner's stats of the thread roots in `messages` (`conversation-thread-v1`).
The owner's stats of the thread roots in `messages` (`conversation-thread-v1`).

replayed.doc: True when the key was seen before and nothing changed.

LocalResults.name: ConversationOpResult
LocalResults.doc: `conversation-op` data: the committed revision and the change it made.

LocalResults.name: ConversationAgentToken
LocalResults.doc: The result of both commands (`token` only from `conversation-agent-token`).

imported.doc: The seqs the imported messages got.

LocalResults.name: ConversationRunRows
doc: The steps of one run (`conversation-run`, `cloud-conversation-run`): Home reads the
talk steps' text to show reply segments a live buffer already freed (a mid-run join).

at.doc: The step's actual first-write timestamp, in milliseconds since the epoch.

truncated.doc: The row's text was cut (32 KiB): not the step's whole text.

rev.doc: Local: the step's write revision; Cloud: its place.

CloudRequests.name: CloudConversationThreadRequest
doc: `cloud-conversation-thread`: ConversationDO's `conversation.thread` read
through the proxy (cx-59n8.6), up to `limit` (1...200) replies after `afterSeq`.

CloudRequests.name: CloudSelfHostInfoRequest
doc: `cloud-selfhost-info` (`cloud-selfhost-v1`): who the self-hosted server
the lease names says the person is (`GET /v1/selfhost/info`, asked by the
daemon without a token). Refused (`not_selfhost`) under a bearer lease.

CloudRequests.name: CloudInboxSubscribeRequest
CloudRequests.doc: `cloud-inbox-subscribe`: the daemon's shared inbox socket for this connection.

CloudRequests.name: CloudMessageRequestsRequest
doc: `cloud-requests-list`: the account's open message requests (the Worker's `home.requests.list`,
plans/cmux-next/home-messaging-invites/DESIGN.md 2.3): invites from people the user is not
connected to, for the verified email the app's lease is for. Answered with
`CloudConversationOp.acceptRequest` or `.dismissRequest(block:)`.

CloudRequests.name: CloudConversationOpRequest
doc: `cloud-conversation-op`: one typed op, forwarded with the client's key
and origin. A retry with the same key answers `replayed: true`.

conversation.doc: Required, except for `dm.open` and `conversation.create`, which must not carry it.

CloudRequests.name: CloudInboxListRequest
doc: `cloud-inbox-list`: one page of the account inbox (UserDO `inbox.list`), `limit` entries from
`cursor` (the `nextCursor` of the page before; nil: the first page).

CloudRequests.name: CloudConversationSnapshotRequest
CloudRequests.doc: `cloud-conversation-snapshot`: the head and the newest `tail` (1...50) messages.

maxTail.doc: The owner returns at most this many messages.

CloudRequests.name: CloudConversationTypingRequest
doc: `cloud-conversation-typing {conversation, on}` (`cloud-conversation-typing-v1`): the person is
typing (`on`) or stopped in a subscribed Cloud conversation. The daemon sends the owner's
ephemeral typing frame on the conversation's shared socket; nothing is stored. A conversation
no client subscribes is refused `not_subscribed`.

CloudRequests.name: CloudHostReplicaSetRequest
doc: `cloud-host-replica-set`: leases the install token to the publisher. The
daemon keeps it in memory only and never returns it. A lease for the same
user, install and origin is a renewal that keeps the open socket.

api_base_url.doc: An https origin, or http with a loopback host; no path.

host_name.doc: The name phones show for this Mac.

CloudRequests.name: CloudHostReplicaClearRequest
doc: `cloud-host-replica-clear`: drops the lease. `purge` deletes the cloud
copy first; the lease goes when the cloud confirms.

CloudRequests.name: CloudConversationLiveRequest
doc: `cloud-conversation-live {conversation}` (`cloud-chief-live-v1`): asks a
subscribed Cloud conversation's owner for its `run.live` snapshot; the
answer comes later as a `cloud-conversation-live` event.

CloudRequests.name: CloudConversationRunRequest
CloudRequests.doc: `cloud-conversation-run {conversation, agent, run}` (`cloud-conversation-runs-v1`): a Cloud Chief's run.

CloudRequests.name: CloudConversationRunsRequest
CloudRequests.doc: Persisted runs of one hosted Chief; the brain lists newest first.

CloudResults.name: CloudConversationSnapshot
doc: `cloud-conversation-snapshot` data: the head (`rev`) and the newest
messages, ascending; `seq` is the owner stream's sequence.

threads.doc: The owner's stats of the thread roots in `messages` (`conversation-thread-v1`).
The owner's stats of the thread roots in `messages` (`conversation-thread-v1`).

CloudResults.name: CloudConversationTyping
doc: `cloud-conversation-typing`: someone in a subscribed Cloud conversation started or stopped
typing (the owner's `conversation-typing` broadcast). Ephemeral: never stored or replayed.

account.doc: The cloud account (the lease's `sub`) this event came through.
